name: io.github.verivus-oss/sqry
title: sqry - Semantic Code Search
description: AST-based semantic code search: 39 tools over 37 languages. Call tracing and impact analysis.

packageArguments.name: --no-daemon
packageArguments.description: Run the MCP server standalone, skipping the optional sqryd daemon probe

environmentVariables.name: SQRY_MCP_WORKSPACE_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the repository sqry should index and search

runtimeArguments.name: --mount
runtimeArguments.description: Bind mount the host workspace into the container

tools.name: call_hierarchy
tools.description: Get call hierarchy as a tree (incoming or outgoing)

tools.name: complexity_metrics
tools.description: Estimate function complexity from call graph and line count

tools.name: context_propagation
tools.description: Detect Go call-sites that leak context.Context propagation: callers with ctx + ctx-accepting callees where ctx is not threaded. Modes: break_site (sync), unthreaded_goroutine (go f), http_handler_leak (http.HandlerFunc shape).

tools.name: cross_language_edges
tools.description: List cross-language call edges where caller/callee languages differ

tools.name: dependency_impact
tools.description: Analyze what would break if a symbol is changed or removed (reverse dependency analysis)

tools.name: direct_callees
tools.description: Find immediate callees of a symbol (depth=1)

tools.name: direct_callers
tools.description: Find immediate callers of a symbol (depth=1)

tools.name: expand_cache_status
tools.description: Get the status of the macro expansion cache (.sqry/expand-cache/)

tools.name: explain_code
tools.description: Explain a symbol with optional context and relations

tools.name: export_graph
tools.description: Export a dependency subgraph as JSON, DOT, D2, or Mermaid

tools.name: find_cycles
tools.description: Find circular dependencies in calls, imports, or modules

tools.name: find_duplicates
tools.description: Find duplicate functions, signatures, or structs

tools.name: find_unused
tools.description: Find unreachable or unused symbols

tools.name: generate_overview
tools.description: One-call repository orientation map: summary + health, load-bearing hubs, path/package subsystems, complexity hotspots, potential issues, and ready-to-run sqry queries

tools.name: get_definition
tools.description: Find where a symbol is defined

tools.name: get_document_symbols
tools.description: Get all symbols (functions, classes, etc.) defined in a specific file.

tools.name: get_graph_stats
tools.description: Get node, edge, file counts and language breakdown

tools.name: get_hover_info
tools.description: Get symbol signature, documentation, and type info

tools.name: get_index_status
tools.description: Get the current status and metadata of the symbol index

tools.name: get_insights
tools.description: Get codebase health metrics including cycle and quality indicators

tools.name: get_references
tools.description: Find all references to a symbol

tools.name: get_workspace_symbols
tools.description: Search symbols by name across the workspace

tools.name: hierarchical_search
tools.description: Search symbols with results grouped by file and container for RAG

tools.name: is_node_in_cycle
tools.description: Check if a specific symbol participates in a cycle

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List indexed files, optionally filtered by language

tools.name: list_symbols
tools.description: List indexed symbols, filterable by kind and language

tools.name: pattern_search
tools.description: Find symbols by substring match on name

tools.name: rebuild_index
tools.description: Rebuild the code graph index from source files

tools.name: relation_query
tools.description: Query callers, callees, imports, exports, or returns for a symbol

tools.name: rules_run
tools.description: Run a declarative rule-layer rule or pack against the workspace graph: resolves a shipped Rust DSL rule/pack by stable id (e.g. bbnty.recipes, bbnty.intake, bbnty.all) or a TOML rule pack by workspace path, runs the production rule engine, and returns each rule's structured output plus witness. Rules needing cross-snapshot or similarity routes are reported as unsupported until the coordinator surface lands.

tools.name: search_similar
tools.description: Find symbols similar to a reference symbol using fuzzy matching

tools.name: semantic_diff
tools.description: Compare symbol-level changes between git refs

tools.name: semantic_search
tools.description: Search symbols by name, kind, visibility, and language. Phase A C indirect-call precision (U18.1) adds three C-scoped predicates: `address_taken:true|false`, `resolved_via:direct|type_match|binding_plane`, and `callsite_promiscuous:true|false`. These are populated by the C plugin only; on non-C nodes they evaluate to false. For incremental cache behaviour and structural-IR query authoring, prefer `sqry_query`.

tools.name: show_dependencies
tools.description: Show dependency tree for a file or symbol

tools.name: sqry_query
tools.description: Execute a structural query via the sqry-db planner: parses a predicate-chain text syntax (kind:function has:caller ...), runs it against the unified graph, and returns matching nodes with file+line metadata

tools.name: structural_similar
tools.description: Find functions structurally similar to a reference function via the identifier-blind body-shape descriptor (control-flow shape + MinHash); reports exact shape_hash identity plus approximate Jaccard. Distinct from name-based search_similar.

tools.name: subgraph
tools.description: Extract a focused subgraph around seed symbols for RAG retrieval

tools.name: trace_path
tools.description: Find ranked call paths between two symbols with cross-language support

tools.name: workspace_status
tools.description: Return the aggregate WorkspaceIndexStatus for the active logical workspace, with workspace identity and structure projection
